title: King's proposed LEARNS amendment struck down on Senate floor - Harrison Daily
text:
LITTLE ROCK – Senator Bryan King defended a proposed resolution before the Senate that would put new restrictions on how LEARNS money was distributed. It was voted down on its third reading. …
